title: Reproducibility Study of Cooperation, Competition, and Maliciousness: LLM-Stakeholders Interactive Negotiation
reasoning: The paper is a technical reproducibility study and extension of a negotiation benchmark for LLMs. While it introduces an inequality metric to assess 'fairness' in deal outcomes and evaluates 'malicious' (adversarial) behavior, these are handled as game-theoretic and strategic metrics rather than a benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethical systems.
